edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Battle Dance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Zilean Chronoshift (R): cooldown 120s early down to 60s at max — the target goes untargetable through your commit, so wait it out rather than dumping everything, then swap focus when it glows. - Your E Battle Dance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
